name: game-generalist
description: Playable-game studio for creators: a one-sentence promise becomes a playable greybox you try, a locked look, a built original game and a measured playtest report, on web (three.js, Phaser, canvas), Godot, Unity or Unreal, with scripted bots and gates for errors, win and lose paths, restart, determinism, frame time and softlocks.
